router_correction_after_batch.problem: The batch process matched CAE MeshNodeArray.findAt with an ODB-only behavior regex that allowed an optional Odb prefix.
router_correction_after_batch.fix: Current source routes only the exact OdbMeshNodeArray runtime type to openOdb; plain MeshNodeArray now receives no ODB note.

router_correction_after_batch.batch_boundary: The evaluator process imported the old regex before the source edit, so this frozen final15 batch still contains the misroute and must not be described as post-fix Product evidence.

comparison.historical_accepted_v6: full final9/no-Shell passed 2/3; its two task-started attempts passed with 28/10 and 12/3 model/Abaqus calls
comparison.final13_time_neighbor: automatic final13 passed 1/3; two pre-file timeouts and one 24/8 task-started oracle pass
comparison.final15_treatment: 0/3; one 31/12/0 runtime-budget failure, one pre-file HTTP 500, and one pre-file timeout
comparison.interpretation: final15 plus the convergence instruction did not improve B31. Transport remains stochastic, while the only task-started treatment run regressed into a new ownership/probe loop. The accepted B31 configuration remains historical v6.

decision.b31_default: Do not replace full-final9/no-Shell v6 with final13 or final15 automatic.
decision.catalog_status: final15 remains the current general experimental Catalog because its added BeamSection scope is licensed and narrow, but B31 routing must stay task-evaluated rather than globally assumed beneficial.
decision.next_b31_action: No additional B31 rerun is justified by this batch. Further work should target the independent-instance/mesh ownership failure only if it repeats in another formal task or a bounded treatment is defined.

limits: The batch used the pre-fix over-broad MeshNodeArray ODB route; current source is narrower but has no post-fix B31 Product batch.
Two attempts failed in transport, so the task-started sample size is one.
Note delivery and local adoption did not imply Solver entry or task success.
The treatment changes both the Catalog artifact and convergence instruction relative to final13, so their effects cannot be separated.
